descriptions.w3d_apply_alpha_test_8016a3ac: Sets the alpha compare: always pass when disabled, else a table compare function with a reference byte converted from a float (quantized store); sets z-compare location.
descriptions.w3d_set_blend_mode_802a0cc0: Changes the blend mode if different: applies it, refreshes the alpha fields from the current colour alpha (quantized load) and reapplies the tint when needed.
